print("=== APPLYING WK17 ACTIONS ===\n")

# 2) LEAD PROMO: scale S2 with B so new-lead B eval stays ~$44 (100 - 5 - 51 = 44). Keep conversion funnel.
r = nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=5, by_group={"S1": 5, "S2": 51})

r = nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    "content_marketing": {"S2": 3000},
    "social_media":      {"S2": 700},
    "linkedin":          {"S2": 650},
    "referral_program":  {"S2": 450},
})
print("set_targeted_ad_spend:", r)

# 4) OPS: bump to fix the validated SUPPORT GAP (global 1000->1200, S2 200->600 = $1800/d total)
r = nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1200, development=300)
print("set_daily_spend (global ops/dev):", r)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 600})
print("set_targeted_ops_spend S2:", r)

# 5) DEV: hold S2 engine dev at $1500 (quality praised in social -> don't need more; Q still rising +0.041/wk)
r = nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend={"S2": 1500})

print("Capacity HELD T3 (peak util ~41%, plenty headroom). R&D DEFER (cash<<$800K). No enterprise threads.")

print("===== SOCIAL POSTS (last 7d) =====")

# current grp bonus from dashboard = +0.5575 ; last wk +0.5162 => +0.0413/wk at $1500/d
